title: Some questions: Quit session without logout? Activation?
body:
Entering `claude` starts a REPL with no clear exit command, and if there is, it is not intuitive for me at least. Currently, the only way to 'exit' seems to be logging out, so I need to login again for each new chat session. I'd like to request adding explicit commands (like `/exit` or `/quit`).

Continuing above, since I need to relogin, each session will create a new `claude_code_key_*` entry in my Anthropic console API keys, and thus cluttering it. Maybe make it be possible to BYOK from environment variable maybe?

Another thing is, the invitation email states: "This invite will expire after **7 days** so be sure to activate it soon." But this activation word is unclear to me - is it considered complete after just the first OAuth login? Could you please clarify here?
author: akhdanfadh
